what_works: Magazine-spread editorial layout — large captioned photos of dirt, hands, tools intercut with short prose blocks following 'soil to sustenance' as a narrative spine. Lifts perfectly for a landscaping company that wants the work to feel storied rather than transactional.
what_does_not_translate: It's literally an interactive film with embedded video — the contractor version uses still photography in the same editorial pacing and crops, no embedded video required.
type_observations: Editorial serif (think Saol / Tiempos Headline) for display + humanist sans body; large bold pull-quotes break the rhythm every 3-4 sections.
